data.name: FLAIR
data.detailed_description:
THE PLAYERS ARE THE IP

FLAIR is an open world with no built-in cast. Every character, every car, every building, every business was made by someone playing. There are no heroes to unlock. The people are the story, and you're one of them.

BUILD YOUR RIDE

Describe a car and drive it. From a beat-up van to something that shouldn't exist. Your idea, on the road, in minutes.

RUN YOUR BUSINESS

Buy a spot, open a shop, build an empire one block at a time. Your business keeps working while you're gone.

WORK THE STREETS

Deal on the corner, dodge the cops, build a name. Push your luck and the whole city starts to notice.

THE WORLD KEEPS MOVING

Log off and your character stays. Your business earns, your streets stay busy, other players keep passing through. Come back and see what changed.

This is the first version of a world that's still growing. Wishlist now and grow with it.

Join our Discord (link in the sidebar) for Alpha and Beta access.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (or similar)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / Apple M1
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000a
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Apple M1/M2
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 555X / Apple M1/M2 GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
